issue: Tag sorting utility misorders semantic version tags with embedded numbers due to raw numeric parsing instead of alphanumeric natural ordering.
expected_invariant: Tags with embedded version numbers sort in natural human-expected order without NaN coercion.

issue: Authentication middleware crashes with TypeError when reading token because upstream header extractor assumes exact capitalized 'Bearer' instead of case-insensitive prefix.
expected_invariant: Bearer tokens are extracted case-insensitively, preventing null reference downstream.

issue: HTTP 302 redirects in remote document fetcher are vulnerable to SSRF bypass when redirect targets private cloud metadata IP addresses.
expected_invariant: Every intermediate redirect hop location header is validated against DNS and private IP subnet rules.

issue: Exponential backoff formula accepts negative retry counts and negative base durations, firing immediate retry loops without throttle.
expected_invariant: Backoff delays are clamped to a strictly positive duration floor of at least 100ms.

issue: Cache subsystem ignores CACHE_EXPIRY_SECONDS environment variable because config loader strictly looked for lower-case ttl_seconds.
expected_invariant: Config loader supports both standard environment variable keys and falls back to a safe 300s TTL default.

issue: Semantic version comparator fails to parse PEP440 and npm prerelease suffixes with non-numeric tags, causing incorrect update ordering.
expected_invariant: Semantic versioning normalizes release tags deterministically across heterogeneous package specs.

issue: Asynchronous job worker fails unit tests due to unawaited background task queue flushing.
expected_invariant: Queue runner awaits all pending task completions before returning resolved completion count.

issue: Renaming event payload field from userId to accountId broke event emitter consumers expecting legacy schema.
expected_invariant: Event contract retains bidirectional alias support for accountId and legacy userId.

issue: Semantic code search ranks deprecated legacy_url_parser.ts highest, but active production routing is performed exclusively by active_router.ts.
expected_invariant: Wildcard routes resolve through active production router without calling deprecated modules.

issue: A naive try/catch fix at request boundary masks internal server errors; recovery requires parameter validation upstream.
expected_invariant: Invalid request parameters are rejected with explicit 400 validation error rather than generic 500.
